questions.q: What title was Hamzah given for his strength and courage?
questions.explain: Hamzah, a mighty hunter, was called the Lion of Allah.

questions.q: What did Abu Jahal throw at the Prophet SAW on Mount Safa?
questions.explain: Abu Jahal insulted him and threw filth at him.

questions.q: Who told Hamzah what had happened to the Prophet SAW?
options: A female slave of Abdullah bin Jud'an
questions.explain: The slave woman had witnessed it and told Hamzah.

questions.q: What did Hamzah strike Abu Jahal with?
questions.explain: Hamzah struck Abu Jahal's face with his bow until it bled.

questions.q: What did Hamzah pray for that night?
options: That it be made easy to embrace the religion if it is true
questions.explain: Hamzah prayed for guidance and the next day pronounced the shahada.

questions.q: Why did Hamzah say he was on Muhammad's religion?
options: Because he wanted to protect his nephew
questions.explain: The Arabs were ashamed to take back their words, and that moved Hamzah to think.

questions.q: How many surahs did Zaid bin Thabit memorise at age 10?
questions.explain: Mus'ab taught 17 surahs to Zaid, who also quickly learnt other languages.

questions.q: Hamzah became a Muslim before the Prophet SAW the next day.
questions.explain: True. Hamzah's heart grew calm when the Prophet SAW recited verses of the Quran.

questions.q: We should abandon the Malay language and our family terms of address.
questions.explain: False. We learn other languages but do not abandon our own.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Hamzah is told by the slave woman

questions.explain: Abu Jahal insulted, Hamzah was told, struck Abu Jahal, prayed, then embraced Islam.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A common language of traders of many nations

questions.explain: A hunter hunts animals, a lingua franca is a shared trade language, Lion of Allah was Hamzah's title, and Ya Ammi means O my paternal uncle.

questions.q: Someone insults a member of your family. What example does Hamzah give?
options: Courageously stand up for the family member who was insulted
questions.explain: Hamzah was angered and stood up for his nephew who had been insulted.
